Raytheon Technologies (RTX) researches, develops, and manufactures advanced technology products in the aerospace and defense industry, including aircraft engines, avionics, aerostructures, cybersecurity, guided missiles, air defense systems, satellites, and drones.

stories.title: Boeing, RTX Win $766 Mil In B-52 Modernization Contracts, Northrop Tapped For Deep Space Radar
stories.summary: Boeing and RTX have secured $766 million in contracts from the Air Force for the B-52 bomber modernization program. Concurrently, Northrop Grumman was awarded a nearly $216 million contract for deep space radar. This news contributed to an early rise in defense and aerospace stocks on Wednesday.
